verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents its own building pieces for this story: real-time webhooks with delivery-status inspection and re-delivery, a Billing suite with subscriptions and recurring invoices, and agent access through the AgentOS MCP server and CLI that read and write account resources. Nothing in the evidence shows failed-payment events specifically, automated payment retry logic, or dunning outreach, so the core of the story is only implied by generic primitives. Missing for 10: documented failed-payment webhook events, API-driven payment retry or smart-retry capability, dunning or customer-outreach workflows, AgentOS skills covering collections, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
